stem: Bramblewood Freight wants to look up the ID of an AMI that already exists in their AWS account, without creating or changing anything, so the value can be reused elsewhere in the configuration.

choices.text: Declare a `data` block for the AMI
Declare a `variable` block for the AMI ID
Declare a `terraform_data` resource for the AMI

rationale: A data block only performs read operations and never creates or modifies a resource, matching the requirement exactly. A resource block would create or manage an object, which isn't being asked for here. A variable block only accepts a value passed in from outside; it can't query AWS to find an existing AMI on its own. A terraform_data resource stores a value under the managed-resource lifecycle for later use, but it doesn't query provider data either -- it only holds what a configuration already gives it.
